policy: Auto-accept only if both distinct logical models return supported=True in a complete valid v3 packet. All other outcomes go to human review. Sibling quote quality is non-gating. No requirement on quotes is applied here to either role: this comparison treats each model as a candidate sibling judge.
truth_provenance: Read in full context by Claude (claude-sonnet-5-5) on 2026-09-30, then corrected by the maintainer's rulings the same day; NOT otherwise reviewed by the maintainer. Sample: the 7 real items on which the three tiers disagreed (i8, i15, i16, i18, i19, i25, i28) plus 8 of the 27 items on which all tiers agreed, drawn at random with seed 3 (i12, i20, i27, i6 yes; i22, i29, i2, i0 no). Null means Uncertain and is excluded from accuracy: i15 (a stormwater drainage concern at a rezoning hearing; maintainer: marginal, does not reach the policy of stormwater, not an automatic yes) and i25 (a named zoning case continued on a procedural item; by the maintainer's rubric this may be a yes, pending confirmation). i18 was changed to yes: the consent agenda includes a specific drainage project (Glasgow and Paisley drainage improvements) although the matched phrase sits in a generic services contract. The disagreement items are the hard ones, so accuracy on this subset is a lower bound, not an estimate of general accuracy. Replace or extend with audit-verified labels as they exist.
limitations: Selection/development set, NOT held-out validation; prompts and model selection previously exposed to these items.
Real labels are Claude-adjudicated with maintainer corrections, not uniformly human-scored.
Synthetic and planted controls reported separately; cannot estimate catalog population rates.
No human labels exist for moment gate/grade/choose; no accuracy or numerical thresholds inferred for those kinds.
Intervals are descriptive binomial Wilson 95%; correlated/selected items and many-pair selection invalidate a population guarantee.
Two authorized substitutions repeat NVIDIA Gemma and primary BeatAPI observations; never counted as new logical models.
canonical_route_policy: Prefer native NVIDIA for Gemma/DeepSeek/Nemotron, Groq for Qwen and OrcaRouter for GLM; one original observation per logical model. Authorized substitutions are supplementary repeats, not independent models.
